195	/-! ## §3. The `H_T`-coset relation transports across the base change
196	
197	The two carriers of the presheaf-level face are `H_T`-coset quotients of
198	line bundles on the two total spaces of `§2`. This section proves that
199	`crossBaseTotalIso` carries the coset *relation* to the coset relation — which
200	is the step where the two subgroups being quotiented by have to correspond, and
201	therefore the load-bearing part of the presheaf face. -/
202	
203	/-- **Pullback along the total-space iso matches the two projection pullbacks.**
204	
205	`crossBaseTotalIso C T` was built by base-cancellation, so composing it with
206	the projection to `T` on the `C_{k'}`-side gives the projection to `T` on the
207	`C`-side (`pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso_inv_snd_snd`). Hence pulling a bundle
208	back from `T` and then along the iso is the same as pulling it back from `T`
209	directly.
210	
211	This is what makes the subgroups `H_T = im π_T^*` on the two sides correspond,
212	and it is stated at *functor* level deliberately: the object-level form sends
213	`isDefEq` into a heartbeat blow-up on these pullback towers, while the functor
214	form is immediate. -/
215	noncomputable def crossBaseProjPullbackIso (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
216	    (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k'))) :
217	    Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.snd (baseChangeField C k').hom T.hom)

219	      ≅ Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.snd C.hom ((restrictTest k k').obj T).hom) :=

221	    Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr
222	      (pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso_inv_snd_snd C.hom (specMapAlgebra k k') T.hom)

227	(`IsLocallyTrivial.pullback`). -/

305	    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (crossBaseTotalIso C T).hom_inv_id).app L.carrier ≪≫

311	    (L : LineBundle.OnProduct C.hom ((restrictTest k k').obj T).hom) :
312	    (crossBaseOnProduct C T (crossBaseOnProductInv C T L)).carrier ≅ L.carrier :=

314	    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (crossBaseTotalIso C T).inv_hom_id).app L.carrier ≪≫

317	/-- **The induced map of relative Picard carriers**, one test at a time:
318	`Pic(C_{k'} ×_{k'} T)/π_T^* Pic(T) ⟶ Pic(C ×_k T)/π_T^* Pic(T)`.
319	
320	Well defined by `crossBase_relPicRel`. This is the componentwise map of the
321	presheaf-level face; it is upgraded to a bijection by `crossBaseQuotEquiv`, shown
322	additive by `crossBaseQuotMap_add`, and shown natural in `T` by
323	`crossBaseQuotMap_relFunctorial` — which together give the functor isomorphism

325	noncomputable def crossBaseQuotMap (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
326	    (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k'))) :
327	    Quotient (PicSharp.relPicSetoid (baseChangeField C k').hom T.hom) →
328	      Quotient (PicSharp.relPicSetoid C.hom ((restrictTest k k').obj T).hom) :=
329	  Quotient.lift
330	    (fun L => Quotient.mk _ (crossBaseOnProduct C T L))
331	    (fun _ _ h => Quotient.sound (crossBase_relPicRel C T h))
332	
333	/-- The mirror quotient map, from `crossBase_relPicRel_inv`. -/
334	noncomputable def crossBaseQuotMapInv (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
335	    (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k'))) :
336	    Quotient (PicSharp.relPicSetoid C.hom ((restrictTest k k').obj T).hom) →
337	      Quotient (PicSharp.relPicSetoid (baseChangeField C k').hom T.hom) :=
338	  Quotient.lift
339	    (fun L => Quotient.mk _ (crossBaseOnProductInv C T L))

134	/-- **Coherent-sheaf flatness descends along an affine pushforward** — the
135	converse of `Scheme.CoherentSheafFlat.pushforward_of_isAffineHom`.
136	
137	For affine `π : X ⟶ Y` over `p : Y ⟶ T`, flatness of `π_* F` over `T` gives
138	flatness of `F` over `T` along the composite. Read on an affine `V ⊆ Y`: the
139	sections of `π_* F` over `V` *are* `Γ(F, π ⁻¹ᵁ V)` definitionally, with `π ⁻¹ᵁ V`
140	affine because `π` is, and the two `Γ(T, U)`-module structures agree because
141	`(π ≫ p).appLE = p.appLE ≫ π.appLE`.
142	
143	Flatness on the preimage charts `π ⁻¹ᵁ V` of an affine cover of `Y` is what the
144	hypothesis gives directly; `flat_section_of_affine_cover` globalises it to every
145	affine pair of `X`, which is where quasi-coherence of `F` is used. -/
146	theorem Scheme.CoherentSheafFlat.of_pushforward_of_isAffineHom
147	    {X Y T : Scheme.{u}} (π : X ⟶ Y) [IsAffineHom π] (p : Y ⟶ T)
148	    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
149	    (h : Scheme.CoherentSheafFlat p ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward π).obj F)) :
150	    Scheme.CoherentSheafFlat (π ≫ p) F := by
151	  classical
152	  -- For each point of `X` pick an affine `V ⊆ Y` around its image together with an
153	  -- affine `U ⊆ T` above it; `π ⁻¹ᵁ V` is then affine because `π` is.
154	  have hchart : ∀ x : X, ∃ (V : Y.Opens) (U : T.Opens) (_ : IsAffineOpen V)
155	      (_ : IsAffineOpen U), π.base x ∈ V ∧ V ≤ p ⁻¹ᵁ U := by
156	    intro x
157	    obtain ⟨U, hUaff, hU, -⟩ :=
158	      exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset (x := p.base (π.base x)) (U := ⊤) trivial
159	    obtain ⟨V, hVaff, hxV, hVU⟩ :=
160	      exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset (x := π.base x) (U := p ⁻¹ᵁ U) hU
161	    exact ⟨V, U, hVaff, hUaff, hxV, hVU⟩
162	  choose Vc Uc hVc hUc hmem hle using hchart
163	  intro U₀ hU₀ V₀ hV₀ e₀
164	  refine flat_section_of_affine_cover (π ≫ p) F
165	    (fun x => π ⁻¹ᵁ Vc x) (fun x => (hVc x).preimage π)
166	    Uc hUc (fun x => ?_) (fun x => ⟨x, hmem x⟩) (fun x => ?_) hU₀ hV₀ e₀

188	/-- **The pushforward of `O_D` is flat over the base itself.**
189	
190	For a divisor family `x` whose divisor is quasi-finite over `T`, the pushforward
191	`q_* O_D` along `q = pullback.snd π T.hom` is flat over `T` in the
192	`CoherentSheafFlat (𝟙 T.left)` sense.
193	
194	This is the `n = 0` shape, but **not literally what
195	`AlgebraicGeometry.flatLocusStratification_universal` asks for**: its antecedent
196	carries a pullback along the test morphism, which at `φ = 𝟙` is not reduced away.
197	The bridged form is `coherentSheafFlat_id_pullbackId_pushforward` below.
198	
199	Route: `x.properSupport` is `IsProper (i ≫ q)` by definition, so with
200	quasi-finiteness `i ≫ q` is finite, hence affine; `schematicSupportDescentIso`
201	presents `x.F` as `i_*` of its restriction to the support, whose flatness over
202	`T` follows from `x.flat` by the converse above; pushing forward along the affine
203	`i ≫ q` over `𝟙 T.left` and transporting along `pushforwardComp` gives the
204	claim. -/
205	theorem Scheme.DivFamily.coherentSheafFlat_id_pushforward
206	    {S X : Scheme.{u}} {π : X ⟶ S} {T : Over S} (x : Scheme.DivFamily π T)
207	    [LocallyQuasiFinite
208	      (Scheme.Modules.schematicSupportι x.F ≫ pullback.snd π T.hom)] :
209	    Scheme.CoherentSheafFlat (𝟙 (T.left : Scheme.{u}))
210	      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).obj x.F) := by
211	  letI := x.isFinitePresentation
212	  haveI : x.F.IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
213	  set q := pullback.snd π T.hom with hq
214	  set i := Scheme.Modules.schematicSupportι x.F with hi
215	  -- `i ≫ q` is proper by the divisor family's own support datum, hence finite,
216	  -- hence affine.
217	  haveI : IsProper (i ≫ q) := x.properSupport
218	  haveI : IsFinite (i ≫ q) := IsFinite.of_isProper_of_locallyQuasiFinite _
219	  haveI : IsAffineHom (i ≫ q) := inferInstance
220	  haveI : IsAffineHom i :=
221	    inferInstanceAs (IsAffineHom (Scheme.Modules.annihilator x.F).subschemeι)
222	  -- present `O_D` as `i_*` of its restriction to the support
223	  set N := (Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj x.F with hN
224	  have hdesc : x.F ≅ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj N :=
225	    Scheme.Modules.schematicSupportDescentIso x.F
226	  haveI : N.IsQuasicoherent := pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom i x.F inferInstance
227	  -- flatness of `i_* N` over `T`, transported from the family's flatness
228	  have h1 : Scheme.CoherentSheafFlat q ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj N) :=
229	    coherentSheafFlat_of_iso q hdesc x.flat
230	  -- descend it to `N` along the affine `i`
231	  have h2 : Scheme.CoherentSheafFlat (i ≫ q) N :=
232	    Scheme.CoherentSheafFlat.of_pushforward_of_isAffineHom i q N h1
233	  -- push forward along the affine `i ≫ q`, over the identity of the base
234	  have h3 : Scheme.CoherentSheafFlat (𝟙 (T.left : Scheme.{u}))
235	      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (i ≫ q)).obj N) :=
236	    Scheme.CoherentSheafFlat.pushforward_of_isAffineHom (i ≫ q)
237	      (𝟙 (T.left : Scheme.{u})) N (by rwa [Category.comp_id])
238	  -- and identify `(i ≫ q)_* N ≅ q_* (i_* N) ≅ q_* O_D`
239	  intro U hU V hV eV
240	  exact coherentSheafFlat_of_iso (𝟙 (T.left : Scheme.{u}))
241	    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp i q).app N ≪≫
242	      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward q).mapIso hdesc.symm) h3 hU hV eV
243	
244	/-- **`q_* O_D` is quasi-coherent** when the ambient family is proper.
245	
246	Free: properness of `π` gives `QuasiCompact` and `QuasiSeparated` of the projection
247	`q = pullback.snd π T.hom` by base change, and pushforward along a qcqs morphism
248	preserves quasi-coherence.
249	
250	Not a binder of `AlgebraicGeometry.flatLocusStratification_universal`, which asks
251	only for `[IsNoetherian S]` and `[F.IsFinitePresentation]` — quasi-coherence is a
252	mathlib instance from the latter. Kept because it is wanted in its own right and is
253	the cheap half of the pair. -/
254	theorem Scheme.DivFamily.isQuasicoherent_pushforward
255	    {S X : Scheme.{u}} {π : X ⟶ S} [IsProper π] {T : Over S}
256	    (x : Scheme.DivFamily π T) :
257	    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).obj x.F).IsQuasicoherent := by
258	  letI := x.isFinitePresentation
259	  exact Scheme.Modules.pushforward_isQuasicoherent _ x.F
260	
261	/-- **The `φ = 𝟙` instance of `flatLocusStratification_universal`'s antecedent.**
262

/-- **`Pic⁰_{C/k}` is quasi-compact over `k`** — PROVED, unconditionally on the
étale tower.

Second conjunct of `GroupScheme.IdentityComponent.isFiniteTypeGeometricallyIrreducible`
(Kleiman §5 Lem. `lem:agps`(3)), applied to `G = PicSchemeEt C`. The first and third
conjuncts are already taken in `Pic0Et.locallyOfFiniteType` and

It is the side condition of mathlib's valuative criterion, and the reason the
valuative route to properness is available on this tower and not merely on the
`picSharp` one. -/

variable {K : Type u} [Field K]

/-- **Milne §I.1 Corollary 1.4 over an arbitrary field: an abelian variety is
commutative.**

Same conclusion as `isCommMonObj_of_isProper_smooth_of_package` with the `[IsAlgClosed]`
binder deleted. The proof is mathlib's Stacks 0BFD
(`isCommMonObj_of_isProper_of_geometricallyIntegral`) after observing that
`GeometricallyIntegral` is synthesised from the project's four-instance package — a smooth
geometrically irreducible scheme over a field is geometrically integral. -/
theorem isCommMonObj_of_package_arbitraryField (A : Over (Spec (.of K)))
    [GrpObj A] [IsProper A.hom] [Smooth A.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible A.hom] :
    IsCommMonObj A :=
  isCommMonObj_of_isProper_of_geometricallyIntegral A

/-- **Milne §I.1 Corollary 1.2 over an arbitrary field: a pointed morphism of abelian
varieties is a homomorphism.**

Same statement as `isMonHom_of_pointed` (`Albanese/AVSelfProduct.lean`) with the
`[IsAlgClosed kbar]` binder deleted.

The descent is the one mathlib's 0BFD uses for commutativity, and it works here for the
same reason: `IsMonHom` is a *pair of equations*, so a faithful monoidal functor reflects
it. Concretely, with `F = Over.pullback (Spec.map (algebraMap K K̄))`:

* the abelian-variety package is stable under this base change, so the `k̄` corollary
  `isMonHom_of_pointed` applies to `F.map α`;
* pointedness transports along `F` (`F.map` of the pointing equation, plus `ε`);
* `Over.pullback` is faithful, and `μ`-naturality turns the upstairs `mul_hom` into the
  downstairs one after cancelling the (iso) monoidal comparison.

No smoothness or properness of `B` beyond what the `k̄` statement asks, and no
quasi-projectivity: nothing in the argument is field-specific once the engine is applied
upstairs. -/
theorem isMonHom_of_pointed_arbitraryField {A B : Over (Spec (.of K))}
    [GrpObj A] [IsProper A.hom] [Smooth A.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible A.hom]
    [GrpObj B] [IsProper B.hom]
    (α : A ⟶ B) (hα : η[A] ≫ α = η[B]) : IsMonHom α := by
  let f := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom <| algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure K))
  let F := Over.pullback f
  let A' := F.obj A
  let B' := F.obj B
  -- the abelian-variety package is stable under this base change
  have : IsProper A'.hom := by change IsProper (Limits.pullback.snd A.hom f); infer_instance
  have : Smooth A'.hom := by change Smooth (Limits.pullback.snd A.hom f); infer_instance
  have : GeometricallyIrreducible A'.hom := by
    change GeometricallyIrreducible (Limits.pullback.snd A.hom f); infer_instance
  have : IsProper B'.hom := by change IsProper (Limits.pullback.snd B.hom f); infer_instance
  -- the `k̄` corollary applies upstairs
  have hup : IsMonHom (F.map α) := by
    have hpt : η[A'] ≫ F.map α = η[B'] := by simp [← Functor.map_comp, hα]
    exact isMonHom_of_pointed (A := A') (B := B') (F.map α) hpt
  -- and reflects back down, by faithfulness plus `μ`-naturality
  refine { one_hom := hα, mul_hom := ?_ }
  exact F.map_injective <| by
    simpa [← Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ_natural_assoc,
      ← cancel_epi (Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ F A A)] using IsMonHom.mul_hom (F.map α)
